thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Pod crashloop detected on gpu-pool-eu-west-2. Cluster: inference-prod. Affected service: runtime-v2 (vllm-worker). First observed: 2026-03-15T02:10:10Z. Root cause suspected: native segfault in fused-kernel.so.

sam (oncall): I’m on pager. seeing ~120 crashloops across 5 nodes. repeating backtrace: `SIGSEGV` in fused kernel during attention kernel init.

ajay (eng-sre): grabbing logs + coredumps now. can you mark impacted customers?

sam (oncall): Maria — can you surface any major customer errors? high-level: model execs failing with 500s, some requests stuck in queue. likely P1.

maria (support): Notifying top 3 customers on the SE list: acme-fin, cortex-health, edu-ml. Sending initial "we're investigating" now. Will escalate to account teams if we confirm sustained errors.

lia (eng-runtime): Quick notes: we rolled fused-kernel.so:v3 last night in canary -> full. vLLM stats show `KV cache allocation` spike then `illegal memory access`. suspect regressor in TRT fused path.

ajay (eng-sre): grabbing logs + coredumps now. Outputs so far: `kubectl describe pod runtime-v2-7fggg` shows repeated OOM/killed and `Container crashed with signal 11`. grabbing dmesg from node-3:

```
[ 12023.456789] Out of memory: Killed process 24312 (runtime) total-vm:512000kB, anon-rss:480000kB
[ 12023.457001] runtime[24312]: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS
[ 12023.457210] runtime[24312]: backtrace: fused-kernel.so +0x12fa4
```

ajay (eng-sre): Also found core dump: `/var/crash/core.runtime.24312` — pushing artifacts to s3://redwood-incidents/4376543210/.

sam (oncall): Live mitigation proposals: 1) scale down runtime-v2 replicas to 0 on affected pool; 2) taint/cordon affected nodes; 3) switch traffic to fallback model variant (runtime-v1 / quantized) via route policy; 4) rollback fused-kernel to v2.8. Thoughts?

lia (eng-runtime): Agree. ordering matters: do traffic switch first to avoid customer impact, then scale down and cordon. rollback is safe but takes time (need to rebuild images). we can hot-disable fused-kernel via env var `REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED=1` and restart pods — quicker.

devops-ci: Running the traffic switch Playbook now: updating routesets. Command: `redwood console routing set --service runtime --variant runtime-v1 --weight 100 --reason "incident 4376543210"`
devops-ci: Playbook logs: `applied routing change, propagation in ~15s`

sam (oncall): Done. Observed decreased requests to runtime-v2. error rate on v2 still high but overall 500s dropped ~70% in last 2 mins. :thumbsup:

ajay (eng-sre): Starting node remediation: cordon node-3/node-7/node-8 and drain with `--ignore-daemonsets` on each.

lia (eng-runtime): Patching deployment with `REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED=1` env var to avoid loading fused-kernel. Patch applied to runtime-v2 daemonset on affected nodes only. rolling restarts initiated.

ajay (eng-sre): After restart, one pod showed `malloc` failures then recovered. No further SIGSEGVs in dmesg on node-3; node-7 still noisy — draining now.

maria (support): Customers alerted: sent update to acme-fin and cortex-health that we are routing traffic to fallback model and investigating native runtime crash. ETA: we'll send another update in 30 mins.

sam (oncall): Handoff: I need to step off for 30m. ajay, you're primary. lia, keep watching runtime changes. I'll be reachable for escalation. handover initiated.

ajay (eng-sre): ack taking pager. current status summary for handoff message: `mitigation: traffic routed to runtime-v1, fused kernel disabled via env var, affected nodes cordoned/drained, core dumps collected -> s3`. Severity: P1, customer-visible errors reduced to <5% requests for now.

incident-bot: Incident 4376543210 updated. Status -> "Mitigated (partial)". Priority -> P1. Pager owners: ajay (primary), lia (secondary).

lia (eng-runtime): Next steps for root cause: 1) triage core dump with debug symbols, 2) reproduce with local TRT build + small config (sequence length 2048, optimizations on), 3) run ASAN/UBSAN in dev env to catch illegal mem access. I’ll open an RFC for reverting fused-kernel change if we confirm regression.

ajay (eng-sre): I've opened incident ticket INC-2026-4376543210 and linked crash artifacts + node diagnostics. adding logs: `/s3/redwood-incidents/4376543210/`

maria (support): I'll keep customer comms cadence: immediate -> done, 30m update -> queued, public postmortem will follow once RCA available.

sam (oncall): leaving brief note: if errors rise again after rollback -> escalate to eng-runtime on-call and consider emergency rollback of images cluster-wide. :warning:

ajay (eng-sre): For the record, crash signature differs from prior segfaults — this looks like a race during TRT kernel init when memory pooling collides with host OOM. tagging `eng-ml` and `eng-runtime` for deep dive.

lia (eng-runtime): collecting repro plan. will ping when I have a minimal reproducer. thanks all.

sam (oncall): closing handoff — I’m stepping out. keep me in loop via thread. :sleeping:

incident-bot: Incident 4376543210 will remain open. Follow incident playbook for P1s and update incident ticket when transitioned to "stable".
